curse one's luck: He cursed his luck when the bus left just seconds before he reached the stop in the rain.
他在雨中跑到公車站前幾秒公車就開走了，他咒罵自己運氣差。
be cursed with: My uncle is cursed with a terrible memory, so he has to write down everything he needs to do.
我叔叔受記性很差之苦，所以他必須把要做的每件事都寫下來。
curse under one's breath: When he stepped on the toy in the dark, he cursed under his breath so he wouldn't wake the baby.
他在黑暗中踩到玩具時低聲咒罵，以免吵醒寶寶。
cushion the blow: To cushion the blow, the company gave the fired workers three months of extra pay.
為了減輕打擊，公司給被解雇的員工三個月的額外薪資。
cushion the impact: The thick mat in the gym helps cushion the impact when students land after a high jump.
體育館裡的厚墊子在學生跳高落地時有助於緩衝衝擊。
cushion the fall: The government cut taxes to cushion the fall in house prices and calm worried homeowners.
政府減稅以減緩房價的下跌，並安撫擔心的屋主。
dam the river: The plan to dam the river would provide electricity, but it would also flood several villages.
在這條河築壩攔河的計畫可以提供電力，但也會淹沒好幾個村莊。
dam up one's feelings: If you dam up your feelings for too long, they may suddenly explode when you least expect it.
如果你壓抑情感太久，它們可能會在你最意想不到的時候突然爆發。
dampen enthusiasm: The heavy rain did not dampen enthusiasm for the concert, and thousands of fans still showed up.
大雨並沒有澆熄大家對演唱會的熱情，數千名歌迷仍然到場。
dampen spirits: Losing the first game did not dampen spirits on our team, and we came back stronger the next day.
輸掉第一場比賽並沒有打擊我們隊上的士氣，隔天我們變得更強了。
dampen demand: The sharp rise in oil prices may dampen demand for large cars, as people look for cheaper options.
油價急漲可能會抑制對大型車的需求，因為人們會尋找更便宜的選擇。
dash one's hopes: The heavy snow dashed our hopes of reaching the top of the mountain before sunset.
大雪使我們在日落前登上山頂的希望破滅了。
dash off a letter: She dashed off a letter to her grandmother and mailed it just before the post office closed.
她匆匆寫了一封信給奶奶，並在郵局關門前寄出。
dash to the station: Realizing he was late, he grabbed his bag and dashed to the station to catch the last train.
發現自己遲到了，他抓起包包衝向車站去趕最後一班火車。
make a dash for it: When the rain suddenly started pouring, we decided to make a dash for it and ran to the car.
雨突然傾盆而下時，我們決定拔腿就跑，衝向車子。
it dawned on me: Halfway to school, it dawned on me that I had left my homework on the kitchen table.
走到半路上我才恍然大悟，我把作業忘在廚房桌上了。
a new era dawned: With the invention of the smartphone, a new era dawned in the way people communicate with each other.
隨著智慧型手機的發明，人們彼此溝通的方式迎來了新時代。
dawn of civilization: Since the dawn of civilization, people have told stories to explain the world around them.
自文明之始，人們就一直用故事來解釋他們周遭的世界。
moral decay: Some people blame violent video games for the moral decay they see among young people today.
有些人把他們在現今年輕人身上看到的道德淪喪歸咎於暴力電玩。
the building decayed: Nobody lived there for fifty years, so the building decayed until the roof finally fell in.
五十年來沒有人住在那裡，所以建築衰敗到屋頂終於塌了下來。
teeth decay: If you eat too much candy and forget to brush, your teeth decay faster than you might think.
如果你吃太多糖果又忘了刷牙，蛀牙的速度會比你想像的還快。
urban decay: Empty factories and broken windows are clear signs of urban decay in the old part of the city.
空蕩的工廠和破碎的窗戶是這座城市舊區都市衰敗的明顯跡象。
deceive the public: The company tried to deceive the public by hiding the fact that its product was unsafe.
這家公司試圖隱瞞產品不安全的事實來欺騙大眾。
deceive oneself: If you think you can pass the test without studying, you are only trying to deceive yourself.
如果你認為不讀書也能通過考試，那你只是在自欺。
appearances can deceive: The small restaurant looks old and dirty, but appearances can deceive because its food is excellent.
這間小餐廳看起來又舊又髒，但外表會騙人，因為它的食物非常棒。
declare war: After the attack on its border, the country decided to declare war on its powerful neighbor.
邊境遭到攻擊後，該國決定向強大的鄰國宣戰。
declare independence: In 1776, the American colonies decided to declare independence from Britain and form a new nation.
1776年，美洲殖民地決定宣布脫離英國獨立，建立一個新國家。
declare bankruptcy: After losing money for five years in a row, the small company had to declare bankruptcy.
連續虧損五年後，這家小公司不得不宣告破產。
declare goods at customs: Travelers must declare goods at customs if they bring back expensive items like watches or jewelry.
旅客如果帶回手錶或珠寶等昂貴物品，必須向海關申報。
declare a winner: The judges needed more time to declare a winner because the last two singers were equally good.
評審需要更多時間宣布獲勝者，因為最後兩位歌手一樣出色。
